login.title: Sign in to the admin panel
login.totpHelp: Codes change every 30 seconds. If codes keep failing, check that your phone's time is set automatically.

denied.ip: Access from this network isn't allowed. Connect from an approved network or contact a superadmin.
denied.host: Open the admin panel at its own address.

sessionExpired.body: Your admin session has ended. Sign in again to continue. Unsaved changes were not saved.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Changes take effect immediately, without a redeploy. Every change is saved in the audit log.
settings.readOnly: You can view settings. Only a superadmin can change them.
settings.searchHelp: Search by key or by the Persian or English description.

empty.noneChanged: All settings use their default values.

settings.unknown: This setting no longer exists. The list was refreshed.

error.type: This value has the wrong type.
error.min: The value must be at least {min}.
error.max: The value must be at most {max}.
error.choice: Choose one of the allowed options.
error.check: The value doesn't meet this setting's rule: {rule}

rule.oddLengths: Odd numbers only, at least one
rule.ascendingUnique: Ascending with no duplicates, at least one
rule.e164: Starts with + and has 6–18 digits, e.g. +983000505

list.duplicate: This value is already in the list.

edit.reason: Reason for this change (saved in the audit log)
edit.ackRequired: Tick the confirmation above to continue.
edit.saveFailed: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.
edit.conflict: Changed by someone else while you were editing: now {value}.

warning.title: Consistency warning
warning.notMultiple: {name} ({value}) isn't a multiple of the coin price ({price}).
warning.noEligibleTier: No table tier reaches the prediction minimum ({min}); no match will have a prediction pool.
warning.pointsOrder: Gammon is lower than single, or backgammon is lower than gammon.

impact.money: Changes what players pay or receive. Players see the new value on their next confirmation screen.
impact.coinPrice: Changes every toman amount shown to players, new purchases, and new withdrawal requests. Pending withdrawals keep the rate from their request time.
impact.signupBonus: Applies to accounts created from now on.
impact.rolling: Limits count over any rolling 24 hours.
impact.gameTimers: Applies to new turns and new searches.
impact.tiers: Removing a tier removes it from the lobby.
impact.predictOff: New matches won't open prediction pools.
impact.retention: Replays older than {days} days will be permanently deleted, except those linked to an open fraud flag or payment dispute. This can't be undone.
impact.retentionAck: I understand old replays will be permanently deleted.
impact.coinPriceAck: I understand this changes every toman price.
impact.topupNoCapAck: I understand manual top-ups will have no cap.
impact.patternAck: I understand players won't receive these texts until this pattern is active.
impact.fromNumber: The sender line must be allowed for the SMS patterns at IPPanel, or texts will fail.
impact.security: Protects player accounts against guessing and SMS abuse.
impact.alsoAdmin: These values also apply to admin sign-in.
impact.topupNoCap: Removes the per-action cap on manual top-ups.

history.title: Change history
history.empty: No recorded changes for this setting.
history.partial: Showing changes among the latest 200 admin actions.

sms.title: SMS status
sms.noAccess: SMS status is visible to finance and superadmin roles.
sms.testMode: Test mode: texts are not sent; they're written to the server log.
sms.notConfigured: SMS isn't configured: the API key is missing on the server.
sms.otpDown: Players can't receive verification codes: signup and password reset won't work.
sms.belowThreshold: Below the alert level of {threshold} toman

consequence.otp: Signup, password reset, and withdrawal codes won't be delivered.
consequence.withdrawalPaid: Players won't get an SMS when a withdrawal is paid.

admin.invalidCredentials: Username, password, or code is incorrect.
admin.locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {time}.
admin.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
admin.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.
admin.settingConflict: Another admin changed this setting meanwhile.
admin.flagDecided: This flag has already been decided.
admin.reportRange: Choose a valid date range (at most one year).
admin.exists: An admin with this username already exists.
admin.lastSuperadmin: The last active superadmin can't be demoted or disabled.
